summary: WOWO ACM v2 Mega-Build backend regression — 20 PASSED / 1 SKIPPED / 1 FAILED (95% pass). Version stamp, geo seed (50 countries + 36 IN states/UTs), all 4 new /api/acm-v2/* admin endpoints (resolver-config GET+PUT, trial-payments GET, tier-segment-mapping GET+PUT) work and persist correctly. /api/auth/me correctly returns the new resolver fields (effective_access_key, user_type, subscription_plan). PUT /api/acm/user/{id}/type accepts all 5 new user types (starter_trial, pro_trial, premium_trial, on_demand_retail_buyer, on_demand_bulk_buyer) + premium plan. Single defect: /api/acm/my-access returns the resolver's effective key under JSON key `access_key` instead of `effective_access_key` (resolver wiring itself is correct — value=platform_admin, effective_reason present). Admin auth (admin@test.com/AdminPass2026!) login works, role=admin resolves to platform_admin via 5-axis resolver bypass.

minor.issue: Response JSON key is `access_key` but the v2 spec / /api/auth/me use `effective_access_key`. Resolver itself works correctly (value=platform_admin, effective_reason returned). Fix in backend/routes/acm.py:223 — rename or also include `effective_access_key` (additive, back-compat safe).

routes/acm_v2.py is well-structured (admin-guarded, idempotent geo seed, proper request validation). Trial-payments POST endpoint is implemented but not part of this regression scope.
geo seed in _ensure_geo_seeded() relies on an in-process flag (_GEO_SEEDED) — fine for single-process supervisor; in multi-worker each worker re-checks DB once on cold start (acceptable).

rca_of_issue: RCA: backend/routes/acm.py:223 in GET /api/acm/my-access constructs the response dict with `"access_key": profile["access_key"]`. resolve_user_acm_profile returns the resolver tuple under key `access_key`, while persist_resolved_type() writes `effective_access_key` to the user doc, which /api/auth/me echoes verbatim — hence the inconsistency. Reproduction: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>' https://repo-blueprint-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api/acm/my-access | jq 'keys'` shows `access_key` not `effective_access_key`. One-line additive mitigation in routes/acm.py:223 → `"effective_access_key": profile["access_key"], "access_key": profile["access_key"],` (no FE breakage).
